/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from urllib.parse import urlencode
from urllib.request import Request,urlopen
import re
seq=''
p={'CMD':'Put','PROGRAM':'blastp','DATABASE':'refseq_protein','QUERY':seq,'ENTREZ_QUERY':'Homo sapiens[organism]','EXPECT':'1e-5','HITLIST_SIZE':'10'}
req=Request('https://blast.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/blast/Blast.cgi',data=urlencode(p).encode(),headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0','Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'})
x=urlopen(req,timeout=60).read().decode()
for pat in ['RID = .*','RTOE = .*','QBlastInfoBegin[\\\\s\\\\S]*?QBlastInfoEnd','rid["'^'"\\\\n]{0,100}']:
 print(pat,re.findall(pat,x,re.I)[:5])
print('len',len(x))
PY"
